text:
ken_support: forwarding customer support case from ACME: Dedicated pool na-east is returning 502/503s for their production traffic since ~06:40 UTC. They report placement failures and timeouts, causing user-facing errors.

ken_support: customer logs attached, showing repeated placement errors and throttling:
```
ERROR placement: allocate failed: pool=dedicated-na-east err=NoAvailableCapacity
WARN autoscaler: scale up suppressed, cooldown active for pool dedicated-na-east
WARN rpc: placement request timeout=10s tenant=acme-corp
```

julia_sre: seeing similar alerts in our pager. autoscaler metrics show spike in queue length and zero successful allocations for 10m.

omar_engineering: tagging infra, this looks like stockout + autoscaler not triggering due to cooldown + noisy-tenant spike. @maya_oncall can you confirm current pool size and recent scale events?

maya_oncall: current pool: 12 gpus. last autoscale event at 06:25 UTC reduced burst by 2 (policy step-down). Recent metrics: allocation failures @ >120 reqs/min, eviction rate up.

maya_oncall: trying a manual scale as immediate mitigation.

maya_oncall: running:
```
rbctl pools scale --name dedicated-na-east --delta +4 --reason "prod emergency - ACME placement failures"
```

deploy-bot: action accepted. scaling task queued id=scale-20260317-01

deploy-bot: scale task completed: new_pool_size=16 (4 added) — provisioning started in 3 AZs

omar_engineering: cool, I'm also pushing a temporary routing override for ACME to prefer eu-west fallback while we stabilize to avoid user impact.

ken_support: notified customer of temporary cross-region failover, they're enabling it for their stack.

julia_sre: note — autoscaler logs show suppression because of "recent_scale_timestamp" within cooldown window. Policy is too aggressive for bursty noisy tenants.

sre_alex: quick repro steps captured from ACME traffic pattern: many concurrent small sessions, KV-cache-miss heavy, causes many coldstarts. We should mark as noisy-tenant and throttle per-tenant burst until quota enforcement kicks in.

product_tess: capturing as customer-impacting incident. Please create a P0 ticket with postmortem and a follow-up to revisit autoscaler cooldown and per-tenant shaping.

omar_engineering: I opened infra ticket INFRA-8942, assigned to eng-infra. Action items: (1) temporary per-tenant burst caps, (2) adjust cooldown to be dynamic based on queue depth, (3) evaluate pre-warming policy for dedicated pools.

maya_oncall: monitoring. allocation error rate trending down after scale and failover. will hand off to eng-infra for root cause.

ken_support: ACME confirmed traffic now flowing via fallback, latency back to baseline for most calls. keeping them on follow-up call.

julia_sre: good. add note: check billing impact for cross-region failover (customer notified). Also collect traces and flamegraphs from the placement service during the incident window.

sre_alex: adding logs + flamegraphs to the ticket. Will propose short-term mitigation PR for per-tenant shaping.

ken_support: closing escalation with customer for now. Will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:

maya_oncall: incident channel leave open for 24h for regression monitoring.
